meta_data.base_class: Retrieve booking details of <services> based on user ID - refers to various types of reservable services.

tool_template.name: get_<class>_reservation_details
tool_template.description: Retrieve <class> reservation details based on user ID.

reservation_id.description: The reservation ID of the <class> booking.

reservation_date.description: The date for which the <class> reservation is booked, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

reservation_time.description: The time of day for the <class> reservation, in 24-hour format (HH:MM). Information around this time will be retrieved.

reservation_status.description: The current status of the <class> reservation, such as confirmed, pending, or canceled.

special_requests.description: Any special requests or notes associated with the <class> reservation.
